# The QRO-Crate vocabulary, profile version 0.1

Every term a crate may use, with its kind, its one spelling, and the checker step that re-derives it if it is CHECKED. A key RO-Crate 1.3's context defines but this list does not is refused as `field-kind`; a key neither names is `term-unknown` (study QRO-0, rule 9).

The prefix `qro` is `https://github.com/loganw234/QRO-Crate/blob/main/docs/VOCABULARY.md#`, provisional (question 6): each `qro` term's IRI is this page with the term's anchor.

## Kinds (rule 1)

| kind | meaning |
|---|---|
| CHECKED | the checker re-derives it from the crate |
| READ | the checker's arithmetic takes it as given, so a false value fails its own re-derivation |
| ANCHORED | bound by a record the producer does not control, fetched from its holder; REPORTED until then |
| REPORTED | stated, not checked |

## Absence words (rule 2)

| word | meaning |
|---|---|
| `unknown` | not recorded |
| `none` | does not exist for this device or route |
| `withheld` | the producer has it and chose not to publish it |
| `unexposed` | the provider gives it to nobody |

## Spellings (section 9)

| spelling | its one form |
|---|---|
| integer | a JSON number: a non-negative integer, at most 2^63 - 1, in decimal with no leading zero |
| size | a string: a byte count in decimal, no sign and no leading zero, at most 2^63 - 1 |
| digest | a string: a SHA-256, as 64 lowercase hex digits |
| commit | a string: a git commit, as 40 lowercase hex digits |
| rational | a string N/D in decimal and lowest terms: the sign on N only, D positive, no leading zero, zero as 0/1, and at most 1,000 digits in either term |
| binary64 | a string: the value's 16 lowercase hex digits, a space, and its exact decimal in cft-fp256's spelling ([-]D[.DDD]e[+-]X; 0, -0, inf, -inf); never a NaN |
| time | a string: RFC 3339 in UTC, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, a fraction only if nonzero and with no trailing zero, then Z; a real time, so no leap second's :60 |
| date | a string: an ISO 8601 date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| text | a string: not empty, with no white space at either end (as Python's str.strip reads it), and no control character but the line feed (C0, DEL or C1), nor a lone surrogate |
| iri | a string: an absolute IRI in printable ASCII with no space: a scheme of two characters or more with no dot, then ':' and at least one character more |
| ref | a JSON object {"@id": "..."} and nothing else, the @id in one of the forms FORMAT.md item 22 gives |
| slot | a slot this profile version leaves empty: only its absence word stands in it |

| verdict | `context` | the @context, or the version a profile's contextual entity declares, is not the one this reader reads |
| verdict | `graph-form` | the graph's shape: the top level; a @graph that is not a list of two entities or more; an entity without @id or @type; a repeated @id; two paths along files, the descriptor among them, whose names differ only by case, or a path both a file and a directory; the order; the descriptor; the root, its type, never an action, and every term it must carry; the root's conformsTo, which is Process Run Crate 0.6 and this profile; each one's contextual entity, but its version, and no Profile entity besides; the root's mentions; a reference that names no entity; a term on an entity its domain does not admit; and, at step 3, a raw result that is not a File the crate holds |
| verdict | `term-unknown` | a key that neither this vocabulary nor RO-Crate 1.3's context names, or a type this vocabulary does not list |
| verdict | `field-kind` | a key RO-Crate's context defines but this vocabulary gives no kind (rule 9) |
| verdict | `file-missing` | a listed file is not in the crate |
| verdict | `file-unlisted` | a file in the crate is not listed in hasPart |
| verdict | `file-digest` | a file's bytes do not match its sha256 or contentSize |
| verdict | `raw-digest` | a raw result's bytes do not match its sha256 or contentSize |
| verdict | `file-link` | a link in the crate, symbolic or a junction, or any entry neither a regular file nor a directory: a crate holds files, never a way out of itself |
| verdict | `raw-form` | a raw result's bytes are not in its raw form |
| verdict | `count-unpaid` | a stated count is not the count the raw bytes hold |
| verdict | `commitment` | a commitment does not recompute, or is not the one the provider echoed |
| verdict | `known-answer` | the decode does not read the known answer: bit order is not held |
| verdict | `measure-class` | a measure's value, interval or class, or the law they rest on, does not re-derive, or simulating the law circuit would exceed the work the measure set allows |
| verdict | `compile-uncontrolled` | a gate list does not pass the exact hold, or holding it would exceed the work the rule allows a crate, or a compile's hold is not what its gate lists give |
| verdict | `calibration-link` | a calibration link or values-digest does not hold |
| verdict | `metadata-generated` | the metadata is not what its generator makes from the records, the header normalised |
| verdict | `step-unbuilt` | a CHECKED field, a raw form or a generator whose checker step is not built yet |
| verdict | `comparison-trivial` | the two runs share a job of a measured role |
| verdict | `question-differs` | the two runs' questions differ by digest |
| verdict | `role-missing` | a measure needs a role one run lacks |
| verdict | `kind-not-qpu` | a comparison declared real, with a run holding a simulator unit |
| verdict | `comparison-generated` | a comparison's record is not what its declaration and its runs' crates give: verdicts are computed only on the runs' data |
| verdict | `kit-dirty` | the kit started from a dirty tree or an untagged commit |
| verdict | `once-only` | the unit's records directory already holds a submission of this unit |
| verdict | `spend-usage` | the instance's remaining seconds or resource units do not cover the unit |
| verdict | `spend-unit` | a job would pass the unit's running ceiling, or one charged past twice its estimate |
| verdict | `spend-cap` | a job's execution cap is not a whole number of seconds from 1 to 300, or is under its estimate |
| verdict | `plan-not-open` | the instance's plan is not the open plan |
| verdict | `kind-mismatch` | the real route was given a backend that is not the provider's own |
| verdict | `route-unsafe` | the real route asked for while any of its five conditions fails: the flag given, the confirmation given, a pre-flight under a day old that holds, a clean tree, every spend rule clear |
| verdict | `key-leak` | the key or the instance is where it could leak, or a secret is in a file the kit wrote |
| verdict | `preflight-circuit` | a circuit the device's current target no longer takes |
| verdict | `preflight-chain` | a pinned chain whose qubits or couplers are now faulty |
| verdict | `preflight-options` | the options the sampler would send are not the manifest's |
| verdict | `custody-chain` | a custody-log line's predecessor hash does not match the line before it |
| verdict | `custody-head` | an audit record's log head matches no line of its auditor's custody log |

## Terms

A list-valued term is always a sorted list of distinct values; any other never a list. A header term is one two writers of one crate make differently, normalised away before the crate's body is compared or digested (rule 4).

A term stands only on the entities its domain admits: `*` any, `./` the root, the descriptor, `local-file` a File the crate holds, or a type. The root carries every one of: `conformsTo`, `datePublished`, `description`, `hasPart`, `license`, `name`, `qro:generator`, `qro:signature`, `qro:trustedTime`, `qro:writer`, `qro:writtenAt`.

| `about` | CHECKED | ref | no | - | body | 1 | `ro-crate-metadata.json` | P0 | the metadata descriptor's subject: the root, ./ |
| `conformsTo` | CHECKED | ref | yes | - | body | 1 | `ro-crate-metadata.json`, `./` | P0 | the descriptor: RO-Crate 1.3; the root: Process Run Crate 0.6 and this profile |
| `mentions` | CHECKED | ref | yes | - | body | 1 | `./` | P0 | the root's list of every action in the crate |
| `license` | REPORTED | ref | no | - | body | - | `*` | P0 | the crate's licence; CC BY 4.0 (question 18) |
| `name` | REPORTED | text | no | - | body | - | `*` | P0 | a name for a person to read |
| `description` | REPORTED | text | no | - | body | - | `*` | P0 | a description for a person to read |
| `version` | CHECKED | text | no | - | body | 1 | `Profile` | P0 | a profile's version: the reader holds each profile's contextual entity to the table's |

## Types

| type | action | owner | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Dataset` | no | P0 | the root, and a bundle |
| `File` | no | P0 | a file the crate holds |
| `CreativeWork` | no | P0 | the metadata descriptor, the question, a pre-registration, a profile |
| `Profile` | no | P0 | a profile the root conformsTo, as its contextual entity (RO-Crate 1.3) |
| `CreateAction` | yes | P1 | a compile, a job, a prediction, a decode, the measures |
| `IndividualProduct` | no | P1 | a device |
| `SoftwareApplication` | no | P1 | a program, a transpiler, a simulator |
| <a id="Question"></a>`qro:Question` | no | P1 | the question: circuits, law, twins, decode rule and measure set |
| <a id="Job"></a>`qro:Job` | no | P1 | a provider's job: one submission |
| <a id="Pub"></a>`qro:Pub` | no | P1 | one circuit of a job: its role, basis, commitment and decoded record |
| <a id="Decode"></a>`qro:Decode` | no | P1 | a job's raw result read through a named rule |
| <a id="Compile"></a>`qro:Compile` | no | P1 | a bundle's compile: the logical circuits frozen into the circuits sent |
| <a id="Snapshot"></a>`qro:Snapshot` | no | P1 | a calibration snapshot: the provider's text |
| <a id="Measuring"></a>`qro:Measuring` | no | P2 | the measuring of a crate's PUBs by its question's measure set |
| <a id="Contrast"></a>`qro:Contrast` | no | P2 | one measure's class against one twin |
| <a id="Measurement"></a>`qro:Measurement` | no | P2 | one measure's value on one PUB, with its certified interval |
| <a id="Hold"></a>`qro:Hold` | no | P2 | the exact hold of one compile's gate lists |
| <a id="Comparison"></a>`qro:Comparison` | no | P3 | a comparison of two runs: its declaration, its pre-registration where it has one, and the record of its verdicts |
| <a id="Unit"></a>`qro:Unit` | no | P5 | a free-tier unit: one recipe run on its devices in passes, as one crate holds it |
| <a id="RawResult"></a>`qro:RawResult` | no | P0 | a raw result: the provider's bytes, fixed before anything decodes them |

## The custody log's lines and the audit record (section 9.2)

| record | field | kind | spelling | list | absent as | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| custody line, received | `at` | REPORTED | time | no | - | when, on the custodian's clock |
| custody line, received | `crate` | REPORTED | digest | no | - | the crate's identity: its metadata-body digest |
| custody line, received | `event` | REPORTED | word:custody-event | no | - | what happened |
| custody line, received | `from` | REPORTED | text | no | `withheld` | where it came from: a public handle |
| custody line, received | `prev` | CHECKED | digest | no | - | the SHA-256 of the line before, its LF included; the SHA-256 of the empty string for the first |
| custody line, withdrawn | `at` | REPORTED | time | no | - | when, on the custodian's clock |
| custody line, withdrawn | `crate` | REPORTED | digest | no | - | the crate's identity: its metadata-body digest |
| custody line, withdrawn | `event` | REPORTED | word:custody-event | no | - | what happened |
| custody line, withdrawn | `prev` | CHECKED | digest | no | - | the SHA-256 of the line before, its LF included; the SHA-256 of the empty string for the first |
| custody line, withdrawn | `reason` | REPORTED | text | no | - | why, with no identifier rule 3 forbids |
| audit record | `auditor` | REPORTED | text | no | `withheld` | the auditor's public handle (rule 3) |
| audit record | `checker` | REPORTED | text | no | - | the checker's name and version |
| audit record | `checkerCommit` | REPORTED | commit | no | `unknown` | the commit the checker was built from |
| audit record | `crate` | REPORTED | digest | no | - | the audited crate's metadata-body digest |
| audit record | `date` | REPORTED | date | no | - | the date, on the auditor's clock |
| audit record | `independence` | REPORTED | word:independence | no | - | the audit's degree of independence |
| audit record | `logHead` | CHECKED | digest | no | `none` | the auditor's custody-log head when it wrote the record; `none` with no log, which pins nothing |
| audit record | `signature` | REPORTED | slot | no | `none` | the signature slot, `none` in v0 |
| audit record | `stages` | REPORTED | word:audit-stage | yes | - | which stages ran: crate-only, and any of the four |
| audit record | `trustedTime` | REPORTED | slot | no | `none` | the trusted-time slot, `none` in v0 |
| audit record | `verdict` | REPORTED | word:verdict | no | - | accepted, or the refusal's name |
